item: Row 436: legacy-restore tests no longer start the index heal on the suite's shared store
summary: restore_legacy_path's closing restart (start_jobs_stopped_for_restore) started the bulk-build heal against the suite's process-wide store; where no earlier test had created derived_meta the marker read failed and counted as OPEN, so the heal ran, its warning landed after the record under test and its job refused the next test's restore. Both fixtures now stub the restart; the scrub test finds its record by logger (exactly one) and checks the passphrase is in no record of any logger.
